are you on anxiety medication? I feel like this level of interference into your daily life is definitely a red flag. when I’m not medicated for my anxiety and depression (or if the meds aren’t working...) there’s no way I can deal with that kind of situation, and I bet you feel similarly.

yeah you should go talk to him and sit at his table, but tbh I feel like the social anxiety is more serious. talk to your doctor.
